normalization: channelwise mean and standard deviation fitted on inner-training source-session trials, applied without refit to validation, development and final heldout
selection: highest subject-equal balanced accuracy on inner-validation future session; first epoch on ties
early_stop_rule: eight successive eligible epochs without inner-validation BA improvement
ERP_loss: class-frequency-weighted cross entropy as frozen loader prescribes

FBCNet.fixed_filter: causal Chebyshev-II, 250 Hz, pass ripple 3 dB, stop attenuation 30 dB, 2 Hz transition allowance

heldout_gate: all 120 checkpoints selected and hash-locked before any final-heldout signal or label read
heldout_source: frozen crossbackbone CSGD fold_plan/evaluation_session; true WBCIC outer cache and OpenBMI final 14
heldout_evaluation: all available sessions; no heldout gradient, checkpoint selection or normalization fit

bootstrap.aggregation: average 15 fold-seed estimates within subject/session; WS-BA is session minimum within subject

SIRE_comparison: requires independently supplied formal SIRE-EEG subject-level true-heldout rows; do not substitute server-local LiteBN
